What the reproduction needed & Where the paper stops & Taken from & What turns on it \\
\midrule
The paper's Table 1 at full precision & prints them rounded & the explorer's calibration record & 20 of 183 published outputs miss on the printed values \\
Quit fractions split into their two parts, then converted to rates & converts in Appendix A and splits in Equation (27); the order is unstated & the explorer's paths & 6 published numbers miss the other way round \\
The responsive quit share, 6/11 & prints 0.55 & the explorer's code & all 226 reproduce on 0.5435 to 0.5470, not at 0.55 itself \\
The log gain's line, anchored at mid-2026 & writes Equation (8) from the 2024 base year & the paper's Table 1 and the explorer & the 2030 gains of 0.300, 0.448, 0.800 \\
The ideas term in the wage & omits it in Equation (16), includes it in Table A.1 & Table A.1 & Section 2.1.3's wage of 1.9 percent \\
Footnote 14's posting speed and wage rigidity & states neither & matching: 0.25 and 0.5 & 3 fitted numbers \\
Footnote 14's employment base & does not name it & matching: employment counted from mid-2026 & 84.25 on that base, 87.02 on the 2024 base \\
The page's dollar scaling, worker split, and typical respondent & defines them only in the page's code & the explorer's code & 12 fitted numbers \\
Cognitive labor valued at its marginal product while the sticky wage is paid & leaves the difference implicit in System (39) & the explorer's code & a profit of at most 0.31 percent of GDP \\
The bracket and the bisection counts & states neither & the explorer's code: 100 halvings on [-4, 4], 200 for the steady state & nothing at the paper's precision \\
The quiz's ceilings on the gain and the slopes & states neither & the explorer's code: ln 30 and 3 & nothing for the paper's scenarios \\
The survey microdata & reports them in Table 2, Table 4, and Figure 1 & not public & those numbers and the page's respondent share are excluded \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
